statements.impact_statement: Measured 2026-10-12 on n8n 2.40.7 (published sha256:cfb73b45). GHSA-g4wm-2vf7-vfgr: the blockUnsafeOperationsPlugin denylist misses include.path / includeIf, so a -c include.path=<file> argument reaches git, and git then loads that file and runs a command it names. The command runs only inside a git process, and this image ships no git executable: apko.yaml installs only wolfi-baselayout, ca-certificates-bundle, tzdata, nodejs-24 and quench-n8n; the full image file list (crane export, 263k entries) has no file named git and only ldconfig and node in /usr/bin; no shell either. Verified inside the image: simpleGit with config include.path plus a push carrying --receive-p rejects with spawn git ENOENT, and simpleGit().version() returns installed=false. n8n source control also refuses to start without git (cli dist/modules/source-control.ee/source-control-git.service.ee.js:74 Git binary not found). test.sh fails the build if any executable named git appears, so this statement cannot outlive its precondition.

Measured 2026-10-12 on n8n 2.40.7 (published sha256:cfb73b45). GHSA-858h-whjf-mvg5: git accepts abbreviated long options (--receive-p, --exe) that the denylist does not match, so git push runs the named command. The command runs only inside a git process, and this image ships no git executable: apko.yaml installs only wolfi-baselayout, ca-certificates-bundle, tzdata, nodejs-24 and quench-n8n; the image file list (crane export) has no file named git and only ldconfig and node in /usr/bin. Verified inside the image: git.push with --receive-p=touch /tmp/pwn rejects with spawn git ENOENT and no file is created; simpleGit().version() returns installed=false. The n8n Git node also rejects push targets starting with a hyphen (n8n-nodes-base 2.40.2 dist/nodes/Git/Git.node.js:311). test.sh fails the build if any executable named git appears.

Measured 2026-10-12 on n8n 2.40.7 (published sha256:cfb73b45). GHSA-x6jw-m9v5-85vh: trailer.<token>.cmd is not on the denylist, so git interpret-trailers runs the configured command. That needs a git process, and this image ships no git executable: apko.yaml installs only wolfi-baselayout, ca-certificates-bundle, tzdata, nodejs-24 and quench-n8n; the image file list (crane export) has no file named git and only ldconfig and node in /usr/bin. Verified inside the image: simple-git calls reject with spawn git ENOENT and simpleGit().version() returns installed=false. n8n never runs interpret-trailers or commit --trailer (grep over the n8n 2.40.7 and n8n-nodes-base 2.40.2 dist: 0 matches), and the Git node addConfig allows only user.email, user.name, remote.origin.url by default (dist/nodes/Git/descriptions/AddConfigDescription.js:4). test.sh fails the build if any executable named git appears.

Measured 2026-10-12 on n8n 2.40.7 (published sha256:cfb73b45). GHSA-v5rq-49vh-5v5c: parseEnv drops VISUAL, so an attacker-set VISUAL editor is not flagged and git launches it during an interactive operation. That needs a git process, and this image ships no git executable: apko.yaml installs only wolfi-baselayout, ca-certificates-bundle, tzdata, nodejs-24 and quench-n8n; the image file list (crane export) has no file named git and only ldconfig and node in /usr/bin. Verified inside the image: simpleGit().env({VISUAL}) followed by a push rejects with spawn git ENOENT; simpleGit().version() returns installed=false. n8n also never forwards caller env to git: the Git node passes a fresh object holding only GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT and GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL (n8n-nodes-base 2.40.2 dist/nodes/Git/Git.node.js:490). test.sh fails the build if any executable named git appears.
